input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves Customer, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to use global exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Customer, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a User, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
